new_findings.title: Scoring trusts exports without checking their recorded digests
new_findings.defect: export_leg writes export_sha256.json, but load_leg_exports reads the payload JSON without comparing hashes; driver._leg_complete only checks that all required paths exist. The score caller therefore does not detect when an export changes after its digest was recorded.
new_findings.failure_scenario: After export, replace media_identities.json with a valid but altered row list and leave export_sha256.json unchanged. _leg_complete still accepts the leg and score_head_to_head consumes the altered identities while the sidecar describes the old bytes.
new_findings.fix: Verify each payload hash against export_sha256.json in load_leg_exports and treat mismatches as incomplete in _leg_complete; add a regression that mutates an export while retaining the original digest and asserts scoring refuses it.
